title: A finite graded Rees module is generated from every sufficiently high single degree
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal, and B=Rees(I) [def-nagata-rees-algebra]. Let M_n be A-modules for n in N. For a in I^k let L(k,n,a): M_n -> M_(n+k) be A-linear. Suppose L(0,n,a)(x)=a*x. Suppose the direct sum of the M_n has a finite B-module structure whose action is the convolution b*x = sum_(k in supp b) sum_(n in supp x) of_(n+k)(L(k,n,coeff_k b)(x_n)). Then there exists c0 such that for every c>=c0 and k>=0 the A-span of all L(k,c,a)(x), for a in I^k and x in M_c, is M_(c+k).

source.place: Lemma 02OA, proof of (1); abstract finite graded Rees-module argument. Independently checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OA on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Choose finitely many B-generators and enlarge them to their finitely many homogeneous components. Their B-span contains the original generators and hence is all of the direct sum. Let c0 bound their degrees, with c0=0 for the empty set.

For nonzero a, convolution on a*t^k and a single homogeneous vector identifies L(k,n,a) with the homogeneous action. Zero monomials act by zero and are omitted; no condition on L(k,n,0) is needed since its additional images only enlarge the spanning set. Module associativity and the degree-zero formula give multiplication of coefficients and the given A-action. Project a finite expression in the homogeneous generators to degree c+k. A generator of degree d<=c contributes only coefficients in I^(c+k-d).

Factor I^(c+k-d)=I^k * I^(c-d). Write each coefficient as a finite sum of products a*b with a in I^k and b in I^(c-d). Associativity moves b onto the degree-d generator, making a degree-c vector; a then acts by L(k,c,a). Thus these images span M_(c+k); the other containment is automatic. This also treats zero modules, I=0 or A, and k=0.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 02OA, proof of (1), expanded into the abstract graded-module argument

lean.statement:
theorem finite_rees_module_single_degree_generation
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (M : ℕ → Type v) [∀ n, AddCommGroup (M n)] [∀ n, Module A (M n)]
    (L : ∀ (k n : ℕ) (a : A), a ∈ I ^ k → M n →ₗ[A] M (n + k))
    (hzero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I ^ 0) (x : M n),
      L 0 n a ha x = a • x)
    (mod : Module (reesAlgebra I) (⨁ n, M n))
    (hfin : @Module.Finite (reesAlgebra I) (⨁ n, M n) _ _ mod)
    (hact : ∀ (b : reesAlgebra I) (x : ⨁ n, M n),
      @SMul.smul _ _ mod.toSMul b x =
        ∑ k ∈ b.val.support, ∑ n ∈ x.support,
          DirectSum.of M (n + k) (L k n (b.val.coeff k) (b.property k) (x n))) :
    ∃ c0 : ℕ, ∀ c : ℕ, c0 ≤ c → ∀ k : ℕ,
      Submodule.span A (Set.range (fun p : (↥(I ^ k)) × M c ↦ L k c p.1 p.1.property p.2)) =
        (⊤ : Submodule A (M (c + k)))
